title: cistus creticus subsp. trabutii
intro: Cistus creticus subsp. trabutii, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose have been found to have wound-healing properties, as well as exhibiting potential antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
